descriptions.d24d_follow_target_8014dd18: Updates motion from the tracked object at +788: empty returns 0, stale clears it; in mode two adjusts motion (0x800cfe68) and returns the mode result; otherwise with +716 set or +824 negative posts a message for an active object and returns 0; else adds speed (+268) * 20.0 * 0.5 to +572.
